name: Health check
summary: Weekday self-check: stuck, silent or paused sessions, sessions lost after an app restart, watches that drifted or missed runs, worktree and board housekeeping. The Mate's panel checks alerts, usage, budgets, disk and keelctl doctor every 2 hours; this run reads what it found and reports to the Mate.

silentMinutes.label: An active engineer with no activity for this long counts as silent

usageWarnMargin.label: Warn when usage is within this share of the guard

minFreeDiskGB.label: Warn when free disk space drops below this

qaMaxDays.label: A task in QA longer than this many working days counts as overdue
